summary: The registrant, INNEOVA Holdings Limited, a Cayman Islands exempted company, furnished a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held on September 3, 2026. Shareholders voted to re-elect two directors, ratify the appointment of YCM CPA Inc. as independent auditor, and approve a 1-for-5 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares and preferred shares. The consolidation reduces authorized share counts while maintaining total authorized capital at US$100,000. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or strategic review was disclosed. This is a routine corporate governance and capital-structure filing, so no further action is warranted.
